diagnosis: Attempt006 advanced beyond the private manager socket lookup into native systemd-run. The owned wrapper rejected runtime input/configuration; the actual first rejection, argument vector and namespace UID map were not captured.

Retained source shows native rootless re-execution in a user namespace, followed by external systemd-run without a namespace override. The wrapper validates host-owned prerequisites and derives the manager socket from its current UID, which are incompatible with this nested view. Pure source/metadata checks reproduce this incompatibility; this remains a source-supported diagnosis.
